entities.name: Joanna
entities.description: Screenwriter, and the friend Nate catches up with online every few weeks between January and November 2022. She finished three screenplays and a book in 2022, writes about loss, identity and self-discovery, joined a writers group in April 2022, and began filming a movie from her own road-trip script in November 2022. She is lactose intolerant and severely allergic to furred animals and reptiles, hikes the trails around her hometown for inspiration, and bakes dairy-free desserts. Nate calls her Jo.

entities.name: Nate
entities.description: Competitive video gamer and Joanna's long-standing friend. He won his first tournament in January 2022 and by August 2022 was making a living from gaming, playing Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, Street Fighter and Valorant. He keeps turtles, adopted a dog called Max in May 2022, makes dairy-free and vegan ice cream — teaching it on his own cooking show in September 2022 — and started a YouTube gaming channel in November 2022.

entities.name: Joanna's brother
entities.description: Joanna's brother, never named, who wrote her cute notes and letters when they were children. Joanna put one of those letters at the start of a movie script in November 2022.

entities.name: Nate's turtles
entities.description: The group of turtles Nate keeps, which he calls his little dudes, these little guys and his little buddies. Two of them as of January 2022, by then kept three years; they moved into a bigger tank in August 2022 and a third joined them on 9 November 2022 after Nate saw it in a pet store. He walks them, takes them to the park and to the beach at Tampa, feeds them vegetables, fruit and insects, and says their calm is what steadies him.

properties.aliases: my little dudes; these little guys; my little buddies

entities.name: Max
entities.description: The dog Nate adopted on 20 May 2022. Full of energy, he keeps Nate's turtles active, and a walk with him five days later led Nate to befriend a couple living nearby who have a dog of their own.

entities.name: Tilly
entities.description: The dog Joanna had back in Michigan, called Tilly. Her family had to give the dog up when Joanna's animal allergy developed, and Joanna named the stuffed dog Nate gave her after this one, to remember when she could still hold an animal.

entities.name: Tilly the stuffed dog
entities.description: The stuffed toy dog Nate gave Joanna on 25 May 2022 to remind her of good vibes. She named it Tilly after the dog she once had in Michigan, keeps it with her while she writes, and said in October 2022 that it helps her stay focused.

entities.name: Nate's gaming setup
entities.description: The gaming room, computer and peripherals Nate plays from at home. He showed Joanna the room in May 2022 and upgraded the equipment on 7 November 2022, calling it where he practises and competes, his own little haven, and necessary to beating his competition.

entities.name: Joanna's cork board
entities.description: The cork board in Joanna's room, covered with quotes, photographs and keepsakes for motivation, including a picture of her family that reminds her of their encouragement. She showed it to Nate on 5 June 2022 and he said he should start one of his own.

entities.name: Whispering Falls
entities.description: The waterfall Joanna photographed while hiking near her town in May 2022. She called it peaceful and serene and said the rush of the water was soothing.

entities.name: Woodhaven
entities.description: A small town in the Midwest that Joanna visited on a research road trip shortly before 10 July 2022. She saw its scenery and historic buildings and found a book from the 1900s of stories and sketches in its library; how much the town had changed sparked ideas for her next script.

entities.name: Michigan
entities.description: Where Joanna had her dog Tilly, before the allergy that made her family give the dog up.

entities.name: Fort Wayne
entities.description: The place Joanna hiked near in the summer of 2021, where she took the sunflower-and-sunset photograph she showed Nate in November 2022.

entities.name: Tampa
entities.description: Where Nate took his turtles to the beach on 10 November 2022.

entities.name: the hiking trails around Joanna's hometown
entities.description: The trails Joanna hikes, which she refers to as being in her hometown and in her town. She found one on 16 April 2022 and more of them in the week before 12 May 2022, Whispering Falls among them, and says being out on them makes her feel she could write a whole movie.

entities.name: Joanna's writers group
entities.description: The writers group Joanna joined on 21 April 2022, which she also calls her writing club. She writes the script Finding Home with them, shared her book with them in the week before 22 August 2022 and got great feedback, and made a bookmark for one of its members in October 2022.

entities.name: Nate's vegan diet group
entities.description: The vegan diet group Nate belongs to. He made vegan ice cream on 17 June 2022 and shared it with them.

entities.name: Nate's cooking show
entities.description: Nate's own cooking show, on which he taught people vegan ice cream recipes on 12 September 2022. He found it nerve-wracking but a blast, picked up a few new recipes from it, and named coconut milk ice cream as his favourite dish from the show.

entities.name: Finding Home
entities.description: The script Joanna writes with her writers group, about a girl on a journey to find her true home. She described it in April 2022 as rewarding and emotional.

entities.name: Little Women
entities.description: The film Joanna watched and recommended to Nate on 7 February 2022 for its story of sisterhood, love and reaching for your dreams. Nate watched it shortly before 6 October 2022 and thought the acting and the story were great.

entities.name: The Lord of the Rings trilogy
entities.description: The film trilogy Nate named as one of his favourites on 21 April 2022 for its world building, battles and storytelling. Joanna watched it on his recommendation on 1 May 2022 and thought it was awesome; Nate called it probably the greatest trilogy of all time.

properties.aliases: LOTR; The Lord of the Rings

entities.name: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive
entities.description: The team shooter Nate won his first video game tournament with in the week before 21 January 2022, and the game he says he usually plays.

entities.name: Street Fighter
entities.description: The fighting game Nate plays a lot with his friends and won a local tournament with in the week before 2 May 2022 — his second tournament win, and a surprise to him.

entities.name: Valorant
entities.description: The game whose big tournament Nate reached the final of, and won, on 5 November 2022.

entities.name: Catan
entities.description: The strategy board game of building settlements and trading resources that Nate played with new acquaintances at a game convention on 7 October 2022. He loves it, and said the group were competitive but still relaxed about it.

entities.name: Inception
entities.description: The film Nate saw shortly before 9 October 2022; he said its twists and dream material blew his mind.

entities.name: Cyberpunk 2077
entities.description: The game with a futuristic setting and gameplay that Nate said on 9 October 2022 he had been playing nonstop.

entities.name: Xenoblade Chronicles
entities.description: The fantasy Nintendo role-playing game Nate was playing on 7 November 2022 and recommended to Joanna. He had wanted to play it for a while because his friends recommended it, and spelled it Xeonoblade Chronicles.

entities.name: the romantic drama about memory and relationships that Joanna recommended
entities.description: An unnamed romantic drama about memory and relationships, one of Joanna's favourite films. She first watched it about three years before January 2022, has seen it a few times, likes the idea and the acting, owns a physical copy, and recommended it to Nate on 21 January 2022.

entities.name: Joanna's first screenplay
entities.description: Joanna's first full screenplay, a mix of drama and romance, finished and printed on 21 January 2022 after a long stretch of work. She submitted it to film festivals hoping a producer or director would pick it up, and on 3 June 2022 received a generic rejection letter from a major company with no feedback.

entities.name: Joanna's second screenplay
entities.description: The screenplay Joanna started on 25 February 2022 and finished on 18 March 2022: a thirty-year-old woman takes a road trip to heal and work out who she is after a loss. Joanna called it her own story, inspired by her own journey of self-discovery, and by 11 November 2022 she was filming her own movie from this road-trip script.

entities.name: Joanna's third screenplay
entities.description: The screenplay Joanna finished on 20 May 2022, about loss, identity and connection. A story she had carried for years and only then found the courage to write; she said it was hard and that she is proudest of it.

entities.name: Joanna's book
entities.description: The book Joanna started writing around July 2022 after her movie did well: a deep, emotional story exploring loss, redemption and forgiveness. She shared it with her writers group in the week before 22 August 2022 and got great feedback, and finished writing it in the week before 6 October 2022 after many late nights. She has never published a book and said this might be the first.

entities.name: Joanna's Midwestern thriller script
entities.description: A suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town, which Joanna was writing on 9 November 2022 and called a great creative outlet. Joined here with the next script that Woodhaven's history gave her ideas for in July 2022, since Woodhaven is the small Midwestern town she researched and she said then that it would be different from her previous work.

entities.name: Joanna's love-story script
entities.description: The movie script Joanna was writing on 7 November 2022: a love story with lots of challenges, whose idea came to her in a dream, and whose opening she finished that day around a letter her brother wrote her when they were children. Kept apart from her Midwestern thriller, which she described two days later as a different, new project.

entities.name: Nate's YouTube gaming channel
entities.description: The gaming content Nate started making for YouTube in November 2022, to entertain people and to satisfy his craving for video games between tournaments, hoping to connect with others who love gaming. Joanna advised him to study other people's videos first so his own would not flop, which he was already doing.

entities.name: writing
entities.description: Joanna's writing — screenplays, a book, a blog post, a journal and notes of her favourite memories. It is both her career and how she copes: she says it lets her build worlds and express her feelings, and that she cannot imagine life without it. She gave Nate advice on taking it up in March 2022.

entities.name: hiking
entities.description: Hiking, which Joanna does on the trails around her hometown to reset and to find inspiration; she called herself an expert hiker in May 2022. Nate is not into hiking but said he might enjoy going with her.

entities.name: competitive video gaming
entities.description: Nate's video gaming, from playing for fun to a career: his first tournament win in January 2022, a local Street Fighter win, regional wins, an online fourth win, an international win in August 2022 and a Valorant final in November 2022, with setbacks in September and November 2022. He practises at home, says the tournaments bring out strong emotions in him, and by August 2022 was making a living at it.

entities.name: making dairy-free desserts
entities.description: The dairy-free and vegan dessert making both of them do and swap recipes about all year: Nate's coconut milk ice cream, first made on 7 February 2022, his dairy-free chocolate cake and mousse and the vegan ice cream he taught on his cooking show; Joanna's cakes, tarts and cupcakes, which are dairy-free because she is lactose intolerant.

entities.name: acting
entities.description: Acting, which Joanna called her first passion, before writing. She was so nervous in her first play that she forgot her lines, and she has not ruled out going back to it one day.

entities.name: Joanna's animal allergy
entities.description: Joanna's severe allergy to most reptiles and to animals with fur: her face goes puffy and itchy near them, so she has always stayed away. She learned in early 2022 that she is allergic to cockroaches too. The allergy cost her the dog Tilly in Michigan and is why she keeps no pets, watching Nate's turtles from a distance instead.

entities.name: Joanna's lactose intolerance
entities.description: Joanna cannot have dairy, which is why every dessert she bakes or asks Nate for a recipe of is dairy-free, and why she cannot eat the ice cream he makes with cream.

claims.text: Nate said he loves watching classics and would check out the romantic drama Joanna recommended to him on 21 January 2022.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: As of 23 January 2022 Nate had two turtles, which he had kept for three years; he said they brought him tons of joy, had big personalities despite their size, and kept him calm when something important made him nervous.

claims.speaker: Nate

claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's animal allergy is severe: her face goes puffy and itchy around certain animals, she is allergic to most reptiles and to animals with fur, and she has always stayed away from them.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: In place of pets, Joanna said on 23 January 2022 that writing and spending time with friends are what bring her joy: writing lets her create wild worlds and characters and express her feelings, and she cannot imagine life without it.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: On 7 February 2022 Joanna said the screenplay she had sent to the film festival was on her mind every day and that she kept bouncing between relief, excitement and worry, hoping a producer or director would love it enough to put it on the big screen.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate discovered on 7 February 2022 that he could make coconut milk ice cream, tried it, and found it rich and creamy — possibly his new favourite snack. He was proud of himself for it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate said on 7 February 2022 that he would make coconut milk ice cream again and was looking forward to trying different flavours and toppings.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's favourite dairy-free dessert flavours are coconut milk, chocolate and mixed berry.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate had made a dairy-free chocolate cake with berries a few days before 7 February 2022, and Joanna said she should either try making one herself or pay him a visit and taste one.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna watched Little Women on 7 February 2022 and recommended it to Nate the same day, calling it a great story about sisterhood, love and reaching for your dreams, and a must-see; Nate said he would add it to his list.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna offered on 7 February 2022 to keep giving Nate film recommendations whenever he ran out of things to watch, and he promised she would be the first to know what he thought of Little Women.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate made chocolate and vanilla swirl ice cream for a friend shortly before 25 February 2022, and they loved it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna cannot have dairy, so on 25 February 2022 she asked Nate for a dairy-free recipe she could try, and he offered to send her one made with coconut milk.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna started writing a second screenplay on 25 February 2022, to take her mind off waiting to hear how the first one had done.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's second screenplay is about a thirty-year-old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss, who takes a road trip to heal and grow. Joanna called it her own story, inspired by her personal experiences, and similar in kind to her first one.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: On 25 February 2022 Joanna said she hoped her first screenplay would get noticed and make it to the screen, and thanked Nate for his support.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna finished her second script on 18 March 2022, and said the feelings swung between relief and anxiety about what came next — excitement and terror at the thought of her work being noticed and reaching the big screen. She had been decompressing but found it hard to switch off.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate walks his turtles, and said on 18 March 2022 that walking them always reminds him to enjoy the small stuff.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Looking after Nate's turtles means keeping their area clean, feeding them properly and making sure they get enough light; he says it is not hard and is actually fun.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna said on 18 March 2022 that she would get two turtles that day if she were not allergic, and that she had recently found out she is allergic to cockroaches as well, so she doubted she would ever have a pet.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: On 18 March 2022 Nate offered to send Joanna photographs of his turtles so she could watch them grow without getting too close, and she said she was already really invested in them.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: As of 18 March 2022 Joanna had been researching and networking non-stop to get her newly finished script somewhere, and said it was tough but she was determined to make it happen.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said on 18 March 2022 that having Nate's support through the whole process was a blessing and gave her the motivation to keep pushing forward, and he told her he was there for her.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna auditioned for a writing gig on 23 March 2022. She said it went alright and left her with mixed emotions — excited but a bit anxious — and promised to keep Nate posted.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate was taking part in the video game tournament again as of 24 March 2022 and described it as intense, with a lot of adrenaline flowing.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's shelf of books and magazines is her go-to place for writing inspiration, and she said on 24 March 2022 that it helps her stay sharp and motivated.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate said on 24 March 2022 that he wanted to pursue writing, and Joanna advised him to read a lot across different genres, build a solid understanding of literature, write and share his work even if only with friends, gather feedback, and have faith in himself.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna and Nate agreed on 24 March 2022 to keep working hard and going after their dreams.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna saw a gorgeous sunset while hiking a few days before 15 April 2022, and said it, like Nate's boldness with his hair, reminded her how important it is to show the world who we are.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna had no holiday or trip lined up as of 15 April 2022 because her writing was consuming her, and she was hoping for good news about it soon.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.speaker: Nate

claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate finds his own peace in spending time with his pets and in his hobbies, which he said on 17 April 2022 let him take a break from reality.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.speaker: Nate

claims.speaker: Nate

claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.speaker: Nate

claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said on 2 May 2022 that cooking and baking are her creative outlets, that making dairy-free desserts just as delicious as the usual kind is a rewarding challenge, and that seeing people smile when they try them is a total win.

claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: On 25 May 2022 Nate gave Joanna a stuffed toy dog, saying it was to remind her of the good vibes and was like having joy in her pocket; she said it was cute and that she would cherish it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna and Nate agreed on 25 May 2022 that noticing and cherishing small joys is what keeps life good, and Joanna said that thinking back to the tough times finishing her screenplay made her realise those moments are what make the journey worth it.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said on 25 May 2022 that she could not wait to show Nate her screenplay because she values his opinion, and promised to keep him updated.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: After finishing her screenplay Joanna got a rejection letter from a major company, which she told Nate about on 3 June 2022. It was a generic letter with no real feedback, which she found disheartening because she did not know why it had not worked out, and it bummed her out and felt like a step back — but she said she would not let it bring her down.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate won another regional video game tournament in the week before 3 June 2022 and met new people there; he said the win was a huge confidence boost that showed his hard work had paid off, and that it had been a while since his first tournament.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: The gamers Nate talked to after that regional tournament said they wanted to hang out later and asked him for tips on improving their game; he agreed to help them, saying he just likes helping people.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna planned to hike a new trail with a waterfall with some friends over the weekend of 4 and 5 June 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate was organising a gaming party for the weekend of 18 and 19 June 2022, inviting the friends he had made at tournaments along with older friends and teammates, and getting everyone custom controller decorations as a thank-you for coming.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: On 4 June 2022 a screenplay Joanna had written a few bits for appeared on the big screen; she called it nerve-wracking but inspiring to see her words come alive, and said seeing the hard work pay off was amazing.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate had noticed a Spider-Man pin on Joanna's purse the last time they saw each other, and on 5 June 2022 she confirmed Spider-Man has always been a favourite of hers — she likes Peter Parker's struggle between being a hero and being a person — though she is a sucker for any superhero.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Iron Man is Nate's favourite superhero, for his tech and sarcastic humour. He owns an Iron Man figure that he keeps in his room because it reminds him of something he loves and prompts him to keep working on his goals, and he said the figures make him feel invincible.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna keeps a cork board in her room full of inspiring quotes, photographs and little keepsakes, which she calls her corner of inspiration; among them is a picture of her family, which reminds her every day of their love and encouragement and keeps her going.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate said on 5 June 2022 that he really should start a cork board of his own, and Joanna recommended it as long as he was willing to explain to his friends what it is.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna submitted her most recent screenplay to a film contest on 24 June 2022, just to see how others might like it.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's gaming party was a great success: seven people attended, six of them said they would want to do it again the following month, they played Chess afterwards for fun, and most of the guests liked the controller accessories he had made for them.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate made vegan ice cream on 17 June 2022 and shared it with some people from his vegan diet group, which he said was awesome.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate agreed on 24 June 2022 to give Joanna his vegan ice cream recipe the next day, and she planned to make it for her family over the weekend of 25 and 26 June 2022, saying they love it when she makes them new things.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate won his fourth video game tournament on 8 July 2022, this one played online. He called the victory indescribable and said he is really proud that he can make money doing what he loves.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: While Nate was winning that tournament Joanna took a road trip to do research for her next movie, which she called a much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: On that research road trip Joanna went to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest, where she saw lovely scenery and historic buildings and visited the town library for its collection of old books.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: In the Woodhaven library Joanna found a book from the 1900s full of stories and sketches about the town and the people who lived there; she said Woodhaven has had an interesting past and that seeing how much it had changed sparked ideas for her next script.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said on 10 July 2022 that she was stoked about her new script, that it is different from her previous work, and that it has the potential to be something awesome.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna started writing a book shortly before 10 July 2022, after her movie did well. It is a deep and emotional story whose dialogues explore loss, redemption and forgiveness; she had never tried publishing a book and said this might be the first.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: As of 14 August 2022 Joanna had been busy going all out with her writing projects — a mix of highs and lows — with her journal as her rock. She said writing has become an escape and a way to express her feelings, and that words have a magical way of healing.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: In the week before 14 August 2022 a stranger wrote Joanna a letter after reading an online blog post she had written about a hard moment in her life, saying her story had brought them comfort. She said realising her words had that power was awesome and reminded her why she loves writing.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Between 10 July and 14 August 2022 Nate started teaching people how to make dairy-free desserts, and said sharing his love for them has been fun and rewarding.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate had a new dairy-free dessert recipe he had been making a lot as of 14 August 2022, which he described as creamy and rich, and he sent it to Joanna that day; she said she could not wait to surprise her family with something delicious.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate won an international video game tournament on 21 August 2022. He said gaming had brought him so much success that he was now able to make a living at something he is passionate about, and that he was stoked to see his hard work paying off.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's turtles got a new, bigger tank, which he showed Joanna on 22 August 2022; he said the expansion had made them happy and that his calm, peaceful little buddies make coming home after a long day of gaming better.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna shared her book with her writers group in the week before 22 August 2022. She was very nervous but got great feedback, said it felt awesome that her hard work was paying off and that people were connecting with her writing, and celebrated by making herself a dessert.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate planned to take the weekend of 27 and 28 August 2022 off to chill with his pets, and Joanna planned to spend the same weekend relaxing and recharging with a long walk and some reading.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna said on 22 August 2022 that she has learned that taking breaks and looking after herself matter for her inspiration and her mental health, and that it is all about finding balance.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: On 22 August 2022 Joanna recommended that Nate find a fantasy book series to read through, saying most fiction series are great when you are trying to relax, and he picked one out; in return he recommended a series of his own with awesome battles, a great plot and interesting characters, which she said she would add to her list.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate did badly in a video game tournament shortly before 5 September 2022 despite trying, and called it a letdown and a setback. He said he was staying positive because it is all part of the learning curve, and that spending time with his turtles had been a big help.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna revised one of her old recipes shortly before 5 September 2022 and made a cake with strawberries and chocolate from it; she said tinkering with that recipe and a few others was giving her comfort and a way to be creative.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna was experimenting with chocolate, raspberry and coconut flavours as of 5 September 2022 and had made dairy-free chocolate coconut cupcakes with raspberry frosting. Because she is lactose intolerant she uses coconut or almond milk, and she called making treats that suit everyone's diets a fun challenge.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna had been making all sorts of desserts that work for everyone's diets — cookies, pies and cakes — and promised on 5 September 2022 to share more recipes with Nate, who asked to join her in the kitchen sometime because he thinks baking and cooking bring people together.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's tips for dairy-free baking, given to Joanna on 5 September 2022, were to use dairy-free margarine or coconut oil instead of butter and to check the labels to make sure the ingredients really are dairy-free.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's laptop crashed in the week before 14 September 2022 and she lost all her work. She called it a major blow because her laptop is half her lifeline as a writer; nothing was recoverable, and she has bought an external drive to back her work up so it never happens again.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: On 12 September 2022 Nate taught people vegan ice cream recipes on his own cooking show. He found putting himself out there a bit nerve-wracking but a blast, and picked up a few new recipes from it; Joanna said she would tune in.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Coconut milk ice cream is Nate's favourite dish from his cooking show: smooth and creamy with a tropical coconut twist, and dairy-free for people who cannot have lactose or who want a vegan option. He agreed on 14 September 2022 to share the recipe with Joanna.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna made a delicious dessert with almond milk on 9 September 2022, and said dairy-free is a must for her, especially for desserts.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Besides coconut milk ice cream, Nate loves a dairy-free chocolate mousse, which he says is super creamy and tastes like the real thing.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's favourite dairy-free treat as of 14 September 2022 is a chocolate raspberry tart with an almond flour crust, chocolate ganache and fresh raspberries.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's dairy-free chocolate cake with raspberries, made with almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate and raspberries, is her favourite bake for birthdays and special days; she calls it moist, delicious and perfectly sweet.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna also shared with Nate on 14 September 2022 a recipe for a creamy dessert made with blueberries, coconut milk and a gluten-free crust, which he said he would try.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna tried her newest dairy-free recipe on 5 October 2022 and it was a winner with her family; she said mixing and matching flavours is fun and she is always trying new things.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate won a really big video game tournament in the week before 6 October 2022 and made a lot of money from it. He saved some but was not sure what to do with it, saying he is completely content and has no big plans, and that it is nice not to have to stress about money and to be able to enjoy his movies and games.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate watched Little Women shortly before 6 October 2022 and thought it was great, with awesome acting and a captivating story. Joanna, who had recommended it to him on 7 February 2022, said she had watched it too and that its themes of sisterhood, love and chasing dreams really spoke to her.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna finished writing her book in the week before 6 October 2022, after a lot of late nights and edits. She said she was so proud of it, could not wait to see what happens next, and that dedication is what got her there.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: On 6 October 2022 Nate gave Joanna a whiteboard he had drawn for her so she could look back on it whenever she needed encouragement, saying her life path is inspirational and that encouragement is what got him so far in his gaming career; she promised to cherish it and to remember it when she needs it most.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna finished a bookmark on 6 October 2022 for one of the women at her writing club, and said she absolutely loves making things by hand and knows the woman does too.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate went to a game convention on 7 October 2022 and met people from outside his usual circle. He found it a bit overwhelming but said it reminded him of the good times gaming can bring, and that taking the risk was worth it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: At the game convention Nate made friends who love games as he does, and they had already planned a gaming session together by 9 October 2022.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: At the convention Nate also joined a group playing Catan, a board game he loves in which you build settlements and trade resources; they had a lot in common and hit it off, and he said the game can be both competitive and relaxed — they were competing but still having fun.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate said playing games is his escape from life's struggles, so he does not get very competitive over them, and that the people at the convention were the same way.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate suggested on 9 October 2022 that Joanna go to a writing convention sometime, calling his own convention experience unforgettable; she was not sure writing conventions exist but said she would look into it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate spends his evenings at home playing video games or watching movies to unwind. As of 9 October 2022 he had recently seen Inception, whose twists and dream material blew his mind, and had been playing Cyberpunk 2077 nonstop for its futuristic setting and gameplay.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna watched a classic movie a few days before 9 October 2022 with a gripping story and great actors, which really stuck with her; she rated it 9 or 10 out of 10.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna and Nate agreed on 9 October 2022 that films take them to new worlds, make them feel things they would not normally experience, and are a great way to chill out after a day.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna prefers watching a film at home on a comfy couch under a good blanket to watching it in a theatre. On 9 October 2022 she advised Nate, who wants a setup like hers, to get a couch big enough to lie down on and really fluffy, a blanket with some weight to it, and lights that can be dimmed.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said she gets very invested in small details like her living room, and thinks it is worth it for the little things that end up making life nicer.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna had been revising and perfecting the recipe she made for her family, and said on 21 October 2022 that it turned out really tasty.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate had been getting stressed as of 21 October 2022 because of his tournament progress against tough competitors, but said his turtles always cheer him up.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna still had the stuffed dog Nate gave her in May 2022 and had named her Tilly. She keeps Tilly with her while she writes and said on 21 October 2022 that the toy helps her stay focused and brings her a lot of joy.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna named the stuffed dog after Tilly, a dog she used to have back in Michigan; her family had to get rid of the dog when she became allergic, and the name reminds her of when she could hold and squeeze an animal without an allergic reaction.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate had been practising for his next video game tournament as of 21 October 2022.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna had another rejection from a production company shortly before 21 October 2022, for the script she had sent to a film contest. She called it a setback and said it was hard, but that she would not let it slow her down and would keep grinding and moving ahead.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: A movie script Joanna contributed to was shown on the big screen for the first time on 23 October 2022. She called it surreal and satisfying, said she had been waiting for it a long time, and that it was the third time it had happened to her.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's favourite part of seeing that film was watching the characters she had worked so hard on come alive, as though they had jumped off the page and become real.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna draws her characters to bring them alive in her head so she can write them better, and takes her ideas for them from people she knows, things she has seen and things she has imagined; she said it is cool to watch an idea take shape into a person with their own wants, worries and wishes.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna refused on 25 October 2022 to tell Nate about one of the characters in her drawings, saying he would have to watch the movie and find out; he said talking about it made him want to watch it even more.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate took his turtles out for a walk on 25 October 2022 because he was bored, and said afterwards that they looked tired from all the walking and were relaxing in their tank.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's turtles eat a varied diet of vegetables, fruit and insects. He loves watching them eat fruit because they get so excited about it, and he likes holding them.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: As of 25 October 2022 Nate's two turtles each had their own personality — one more adventurous and one more reserved, which he finds cute — and he said having them around brings him joy and that they make great companions.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate has liked turtles since he was a boy and says he knows all about them; Joanna said she never knew turtles could be so interesting until she met his.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna met movie producers about her script on 4 November 2022. The meetings went really well: she felt confident discussing her script and her vision, they seemed interested and excited and loved the elements of self-discovery in it, and she said being taken seriously was validating and left her hopeful and inspired about the future.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna found old notebooks of her early writings in the week before 4 November 2022, and said it was cool to see how far she has come.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: One of Joanna's early stories, written when she was ten, was about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway. She said that even then she was drawn to stories about finding courage and taking risks, that it is still part of her writing today, and that turtles make her think of strength and perseverance.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Besides the producer meetings, Joanna was working on a project she called challenging but fulfilling as of 4 November 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate had been helping friends reset their high scores at the international tournament as of 4 November 2022, and said it feels good to use his skills to make a difference.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate made coconut milk ice cream on 3 November 2022 and invited Joanna over to try it, confirming it was lactose-free. She agreed to come the next day and to bring some of her own recipes so they could share desserts, and he said he had been wanting to try her chocolate and raspberry cake.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate reached the final of a big Valorant tournament on 5 November 2022 and won it. He said seeing his name as the champion was the best feeling and that tournaments really bring out strong emotions in him.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna finished her presentation for producers on 4 November 2022, and said it was tough but looking good.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate had been busy preparing for other tournaments as of 7 November 2022 and was loving it, saying he is really grateful to have a job he enjoys every day.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna was writing another movie script as of 7 November 2022 — a love story with lots of challenges, whose idea came to her in a dream — and hoped to get it on the big screen.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate said on 7 November 2022 that his turtles were doing great, that watching them is calming and fascinating, and that he has really grown fond of them.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna said creating stories and watching them come alive is what gives her happiness and fulfilment, and that writing has been a blessing for her.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna submitted a few more scripts in the week before 7 November 2022 and was hoping to hear back, though she assumed some would be rejected; Nate said he was sure at least one would reach the screen and be her third published movie.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate upgraded some of his gaming equipment at home on 7 November 2022. He practises and competes at that computer and sometimes plays with friends on it, calls it his own little haven for escaping into the virtual world, and says a setup like it is important to his career because otherwise he could never beat his competition.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate was playing a fantasy Nintendo role-playing game called Xenoblade Chronicles on 7 November 2022 and recommended it to Joanna. He is a big fan of Nintendo games and had wanted to play this one for a while because his friends had recommended it, and said he likes recommendations from friends — Joanna's film recommendations included — better than picking something at random.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna finished the introduction to her next movie script on 7 November 2022 and decided to put at the beginning of it a letter her brother wrote her when they were children; he used to make her cute notes, and it brings back sweet memories of simpler times.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate had a special day taking his pets to the park, where he said they were amazed and their happy faces made it memorable, and he said he treasures every memory.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna had started writing down some of her favourite memories by 7 November 2022, and Nate said he would start doing the same — writing down the things his animals like, and his favourite memories with Joanna.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's game tournament was pushed back, so on 9 November 2022 he tried cooking instead and made homemade coconut ice cream, noting that the sprinkles had changed its colour this time; Joanna said it looked yummy but that she could not try it right then.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: As of 9 November 2022 Nate said his last game tournament had been tough and that he did not make it to the finals, but that he would get them next time and was staying positive.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate was thinking of joining a new gaming team after his next tournament as of 9 November 2022. He had had a few offers but had not decided, and called it a big decision and a shake-up he was ready for.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna worked out a plan for getting another of her scripts made into a movie and pitched it to producers on 8 November 2022; they really liked it, which gave her a big confidence boost and left her feeling she could not stop writing.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna was working on a new project as of 9 November 2022 — a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town — which she called a great creative outlet.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate started creating gaming content for YouTube in November 2022, as a way to entertain people and satisfy his craving for video games when there are no tournaments on. He is a big fan of such videos himself and hopes to share his love of gaming and connect with others who enjoy it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna advised Nate on 9 November 2022 to watch other people's gaming videos first so he would know what his audience likes and his own videos would not flop; he said he was already doing that.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna took a photograph of a sunflower field at sunset while hiking near Fort Wayne in the summer of 2021, and showed it to Nate on 9 November 2022, calling it an awesome reminder of nature's beauty.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate got a third turtle on 9 November 2022, after seeing it at a pet store and deciding the tank was now big enough for three. He said turtles bring him joy and peace and are the best buddies ever, and that he is very happy with the decision.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna asked on 9 November 2022 to come and watch Nate play with his turtles, from a distance because of her allergy. He invited her over the next day, suggested they also watch one of her movies or go to the park, and said he would give the turtles a bath before she arrived.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: By 11 November 2022 Joanna was filming her own movie from her road-trip script. She said it was wild to see it come alive, that every day on set was awesome and full of potential, and that being able to show her vision was awesome.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: The best moment on set for Joanna was when one of the actors came up to her and told her how much she liked the script, which gave her chills.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate took his turtles to the beach in Tampa on 10 November 2022, and said they always bring him peace in the craziness of life.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate said his turtles make him feel calm, do not require much looking after, and are like zen masters that remind him to slow down and appreciate the small things; he loves seeing them soaking in the sun.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate was experimenting with ice cream flavours in November 2022 and made colourful bowls of coconut milk ice cream with mix-ins, which he offered to Joanna on 11 November 2022; she said it looked mouthwatering and that she would love to try it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's video gaming went from a hobby to a livelihood over 2022: in January he had just won his first tournament and said he did not expect to win big and played for fun; by 10 July 2022 he was proud to be making money from it, by 21 August 2022 he was making a living from it, and in early October 2022 he won a big tournament and a lot of money.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's screenwriting went from finishing her first screenplay on 21 January 2022, through a generic rejection from a major company on 3 June 2022 and seeing words she wrote on the big screen on 4 June 2022, to meetings with movie producers on 4 November 2022 and filming her own movie from her road-trip script by 11 November 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's household of pets grew through 2022: two turtles he had already kept three years in January, a dog called Max adopted on 20 May 2022, a bigger tank for the turtles in August 2022, and a third turtle on 9 November 2022.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's dairy-free baking grew out of Nate's coconut milk recommendation: she asked him for a dairy-free recipe on 25 February 2022, was making dairy-free cakes for friends and family by 2 May 2022, and by September 2022 had a repertoire of tarts, cupcakes, cookies and pies whose recipes she swaps with him.
claims.speaker: Joanna
